R-D CodeThe High-Performance AI Agent Fork

Custom features for Zed including Long-Term Memory, LSP-based Context, and Headless Searching.

Features
GitHub

📚 Skill Library

A modular prompt management system. Save refined prompts as "Skills" and hot-swap AI expertise (expert coding, auditing, architecture) instantly.

👤 Agent Profiles

Configure specialized capabilities, Context (MCP) Servers, tools, and default LLM bindings directly from the GUI.

🧠 Long-Term Memory

Persistent SQLite database that stores project context across restarts. No more context amnesia.

📉 Auto Context Compression

Automatically condenses your long-running conversation tasks to keep your requests well under 200k model limits.

⚡ LSP Symbol Search

Native Language Server Protocol integration for 100% accurate, type-aware code context.

🌐 Headless Chromium

Built-in chromiumoxide engine for real-time web search and JavaScript-heavy documentation.

☁️ Azure Anthropic

Native support for Azure deployments and real-time Token Caching (Prompt Caching) visualization.

📝 Hybrid Skill System

Merge project-scoped `.rules` files with your personal Global Skill Library. Instant expertise (security, performance, styling) at the tip of a slash command.

🔍 Custom Search Endpoint

Mount any HTTPS search API (Elasticsearch, Algolia) as a native LLM tool call. The model can autonomously query your internal knowledge base and logs to solve issues, or you can search manually using /custom-search.

🕵️ Full Message Privacy

Audit every outgoing request to the LLM. No hidden telemetry. Total transparency on what data leaves your machine.
